violation_type.title: Toileting Assistance- Prompt (26 TAC §744.2551(1))
violation_type.typical_finding: Based on information gathered during the investigation, a caregiver did not  intervene to assist with toileting while the child stood with fecal matter on his body and was wet for  20 minutes.
